alley_notices.title: The notices
alley_notices.speaker: protagonist
alley_notices.text: Six sheets stapled over each other. A lost cat, a room to rent, a sports day, a lost cat again. The bottom one is upside down and has a time written on the back.
alley_notices.repeat_text: Six sheets, one upside down, a time on the back of it.

record.text: The notices in the alley are stapled over each other and not in date order.

alley_bins.title: The bins
alley_bins.speaker: protagonist
alley_bins.text: Two bins and a skip. In the skip, a school chair with one leg shorter than the others and a strip of tape on the back that says FORM 3.
alley_bins.repeat_text: The bins, the skip, the chair with the short leg.

record.text: There is a school chair in the skip behind the flats, labelled FORM 3.

alley_door.title: The service door
alley_door.speaker: protagonist
alley_door.text: A metal door with a plaque screwed on at an angle: no deliveries, no parking, no ball games. The door has a handle and no lock.
alley_door.repeat_text: The plaque, the handle, the absence of a lock.

record.text: The service door in the alley has a handle and no lock.
